title: Bipartite Extremal Numbers of Trees
summary: We study a restriction of the classical Erdős--Sós problem, the extremal number of trees, to the class of bipartite host graphs, both when only the order of the host is prescribed and when its two part-sizes are fixed. We give natural lower-bound constructions and formulate corresponding linear upper-bound conjectures. We apply a weighted variant of $k$-minimality to prove upper bounds for a broad family of trees including brooms, trees with part-sizes obeying certain inequalities, and all trees on at most seven vertices, resolving part of a problem of Caro, Patkós and Tuza up to additive…
